description: Run a Blazor component in a separate process and show it in a sandboxed iframe, with typed parameters and callbacks.
releaseNotes:
Based on maui 11.0.0

Changes since 11.0.0-rc2
Merge branch 'claude/net11-port-shared-control': net10's shared control work on the released .NET 11 (11.0.0)
net11: no pack hook or package reference that net11 had already removed
Release process doc: net11 numbers and how EditWebView runs on this line
Upstream source from aspnetcore 11.0.0 and MAUI 11.0.10 (EditWebView run)
net11: keep net11's own module-initializer end-to-end tests
net11: the ported cache test passes the cache-control value net11's helper needs
net11 on the released .NET 11: SDK 11.0.100, packages 11.0.0, version 11.0.0
Port net10 since the last sync: shared control, owner key, sign-in providers, opt-in session bar
Document EditWebView in the release process.
Merge pull request #80 from budcribar/claude/net11-escape-release-notes
Escape commas and semicolons in the release notes passed to dotnet pack
Merge pull request #77 from budcribar/claude/net11-port-net10-release
Retarget the ported net10 projects to net11
Prepare NuGet release packaging, CI test coverage, and remote component contract hardening
RemoteComponentHost: ExitWhenInputCloses, exit when stdin ends instead of polling
Keep remote component frames from restarting when the app is mirrored
Mark agent registry (AgentHub/AgentAdmin) experimental (RWV001)
Restore Authorization package references in RemoteWebViewService.Lib
Describe agents and the embedded relay without naming one app
Remote components README: use a generic contract example
Remote components: describe the use generically
Add the [RemoteComponentContract] source generator
Add remote components: runtime and the WPF RemoteComponentHost
Add ReverseMirror to [RemoteBlazor]
Add the [RemoteBlazor] source generator
Port the net9 test-runner and window-sizing fixes.
Install nvm-windows when RunTests.ps1 cannot find nvm.
Throw the frame-ancestor error after the scan.
Name the first invalid frame ancestor after valid ones.
Merge pull request #66 from budcribar/net11-bugbounty-fixes
Port Bug02, Bug03 (dispose-on-throw), Bug06, Bug15, Bug44, and Bug60 fixes and regression tests
Pin net11 to the rc.3 SDK and the patched Graph/Kiota line.
Update net11 dependencies to current rc.3 and stable releases.
Pin global.json to the SDK shipped by the 11.0-preview image.
Fix Sonar reliability and security findings that are safe to backport.
Merge pull request #65 from budcribar/claude/net11-port-net10
Target net11 in the ported embedded-relay library, sample and server branch CI
Let pages in opaque-origin sandboxed iframes connect
Synchronize primary browser scrolling to read-only mirrors
EmbeddedRelayWpf: embed wwwroot so a single-file publish works
EmbeddedRelayWpf: target Windows 10 SDK and show crashes
Copy RemoteWebViewService.Lib into the Docker build and server CI paths
Split RemoteWebViewService into an embeddable library for net10
Gate AgentAdmin starts with AGENT_ADMIN_KEY and guard in-flight starts
Add the agent registry (AgentHub / AgentAdmin) to RemoteWebViewService
Add Linux container mode with Kestrel TLS/HTTP2 for Railway TCP proxy.
Remove net10-only Program.IsContainerMode reference from Startup.cs on net11
Add in-memory event log provider for GetLoggedEvents on Linux
Fail the performance check when the baseline has no samples.
Add the net11 intermittent CI failure log.
Record the nuget.org user and required reviewer.
Generate PackageReleaseNotes for the maintainer to commit.
Spell package suffixes without a dot and add a patch counter.
Draft the package release workflow without a NuGet push.
Add a draft release workflow skeleton.
Read Chrome output on a dedicated thread before waiting for DevTools.
Retry a timed-out DevTools probe and keep the Chrome module classes in one collection.
Measure TestConnectedEvent from the Connected signal, not the pause.
Note SYSLIB1044 on the base-href regex as won't fix.

Full list: https://github.com/budcribar/RemoteBlazorWebView/compare/11.0.0-rc2...24c67bf600e845754a3edfc138ccc97c6f2ccb00
